scope: First curation of two new single-skill reference harnesses, both in the visual-explanation family: diagram-design (cathrynlavery, plugin v2.5.20) and html-artifacts (dogum) — the latter a direct head-to-head with our html-artifact (96% name similarity). The-Claude-Protocol was added and cataloged in the same batch but is NOT ruled here — its own round comes later (user instruction). The family comparison folder skill-comparisons/visual-explanation/ was extended from 2 to 4 skills rather than forked.
method: Two Opus 5 (medium effort) subagents, one per repo, each reading every shipped behaviour-shaping file and producing three-level draft material with file:line citations; coordinator spot-verified every load-bearing citation against the sources (all held), merged into the family folder, and routed per harness-evaluate. No template edits performed — both rulings are defer, so no critic pass was required.
not_reconsidered: all round-001/002/003 subjects (unchanged pins); The-Claude-Protocol's 4 skills (inventoried and bucketed only).
debts: The diagram borrow is one combined decision across BOTH repos (dogum SVG craft rules + copy-SVG device, hardened by diagram-design connector rules + complexity ceiling) — never two separate imports.
html-artifacts' merge borrows are named and await explicit user approval before any edit to our html-artifact skill.
Code-review/PR HTML category: owner undecided (html-artifact 6th preset vs code-review output mode).
The Mermaid gap from round-003 stands — both new repos argue against Mermaid as rendered output.

reasoning: The only diagram grammar in the visual-explanation family: six mandatory connector rules (SKILL.md:266-288), ~40 numeric per-type complexity budgets (:362-404), an accessible-SVG contract incl. the duplicate-ID hazard (:563-572), and an executable verifier (scripts/self_check.py) — precisely what our html-artifact's one-sentence inline-SVG component under-specifies. Deferred rather than merged because: three shipped invariants directly contradict ours (mandatory Google Fonts vs system-fonts-only; dark mode as a separate -dark.html file with zero prefers-color-scheme anywhere vs our one-file invariant; min-width:900px templates vs our <720px single-column rule); context cost is out of family scale (578-line SKILL.md near its own 40KB cap + 7,256 reference lines; a branded animated import loads ~1,400 instruction lines); the ADR-mandated catalogue description would collide with the dataviz skill's trigger surface on bar/line/scatter/radar/Gantt/kanban; its own shipped exemplars are off-skin by the author's admission (references/style-guide.md:32); and the icon corpus carries mixed MIT/CC0/trademark obligations. The borrowable core — connector rules + complexity ceiling, accessible-SVG contract, audience dial, fidelity ledger, degrade ladder — is recorded in the ledger and is to be decided as ONE combined preset-diagram change together with html-artifacts' SVG craft rules, once a diagram-quality failure is actually recorded (authoring-for-agents: name the failure first; note the bar is lower than show-me's because html-artifact already authorizes SVG diagrams and under-specifies them).

deliberately_dropped: Google Fonts typography stack and font-refusal rule

reasoning: A true substitute for our html-artifact — same thesis, independently converged (the editor playbooks arrived at the same export-or-it's-a-toy rule, the same three canonical shapes, and the same config-diff export as our preset-editor: validation, not a gap). Rejected as a shipped unit on five conflicts: the description embeds an imperative ('Use this skill aggressively') and fires on ordinary conversation verbs, violating our triggers-only rule; the offline rule permits CDNs where ours is a hard file:// invariant (their own six examples never use the hatch — verified zero external requests); output goes to the working directory against our scratchpad/ git-safety norm; JS is load-bearing in three references against our progressive-enhancement invariant; dark mode is 'if cheap' against our unconditional rule — plus no no-invented-data rule anywhere (its own example fabricates ticket IDs and metrics). Deferred as a MERGE CANDIDATE with named borrows awaiting explicit user approval: SVG craft rules (viewBox/currentColor/round coordinates/labelled <g>/real <text> + shape-and-color accessibility), copy-SVG-per-figure, design-system-from-codebase persisted as design-system.html, the 'any three anti-patterns -> restart' gate, the 60-75ch measure, and per-preset one-liners (post-mortem what-worked + owners-and-deadlines, plan explicitly-not-doing, status Asks block, marginal glossary, editor pre-fill + keyboard labelling). Code-review/PR category deferred separately until its owner is decided (html-artifact 6th preset vs code-review output mode).

deliberately_dropped: decks playbook (no recorded need; keyboard-only nav conflicts with progressive enhancement)
Claude.ai artifact mechanics (this repo routes those through artifact-design/artifact-capabilities)
